newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent differentials steady, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent differentials steady, trade thin.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel differentials were steady late Thursday in thin trade, traders said.
Several major players were out of the Chicago and Group Three markets attending an industry gathering sponsored by Conoco in Texas, traders said.

"It's dead right now," one trader said of discussion in the market that saw differentials in Chicago weaker on the day and basis in Group Three tracking the drop in NYMEX heating oil and gasoline futures.
Chicago unleaded gasoline was steady at 1.25/1.0 cent a gallon under the print for prompt deliveries and 1.75/1.50 cent under for late-October deliveries with premium 2.75 cents higher.
Group Three unleaded was unchanged at 1.0/0.75 cent under for prompt deliveries and 1.50/1.25 cent under for later deliveries, with premium 3.50 cents higher.
Diesel differentials were unchanged in Chicago and Group Three, and jet/kero differentials also were steady in both Midwest markets, traders said.
Traders saw some weakness emerging in Group Three unleaded differentials on talk of plentiful stocks, with Williams pipeline reporting 21 days of unleaded stocks in the region.
